text:
Jordan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the reliability incident — thanks for the great questions. I'm posting the RCA + proposed actions. Please ack and volunteer for any items you own. https://redwood.in/rca/203001 :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks — can we get a 1‑line timeline in the thread? the doc is long and folks are skimming.
Sam: TL;DR: 03:12 alert, 03:20 mitigation (fallback routing), 03:45 full recovery. Root cause: cache eviction bug under a particular request shape.
Mei: Added infra notes in the RCA about shard imbalance. The short term mitigation is the routing fallback Sam mentioned; medium term is rebalancing and a KV cache pressure metric.
Ravi: I'll take the KV cache pressure metric. Plan: add prometheus exporter + alert. Targeting end of sprint (2w).
Taylor: I'll own customer comms follow-up — we should send a short postmortem to affected seats + a status note to support playbook. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Jordan: New ask from leadership: define SLO burn thresholds that trigger auto-fallback to lower-cost model variant. Who can spec this?
Priya: I can draft the SLO thresholds and the roll-forward playbook. Will need input from Sam/Mei on observability signals. Draft by Wed.
Sam: I'll help with signal definitions. Also: action item list below (adding owners):
```
- A1: Add KV cache pressure metric (owner: Ravi) — due: 2w
- A2: SLO thresholds & fallback spec (owner: Priya + Sam) — due: 4 business days
- A3: Customer comms + support note (owner: Taylor) — due: 1 business day
- A4: Rebalance plan for shards (owner: Mei) — due: next sprint
- A5: Postmortem publish + link in status page (owner: Jordan) — due: today EOD
```
Mei: For A4 I'll pair with infra ops. Putting a placeholder PR today.
Ravi: Acked on A1. Quick Q: do we want the metric on GPU hosts only or on all nodes? I propose all nodes for visibility.
Priya: All nodes — otherwise we blind spots.
Taylor: Comm plan: short note + link to RCA, and a dedicated FAQ for enterprise customers. I'll ping support to prep.
DeployBot: deploy:infra/rebalance-placeholder 2030012560 started by Mei — staging rollout in progress.
Jordan: Thanks everyone. Please post quick updates in this thread as you make progress so I can close outstanding items from the all-hands action tracker. :raised_hands:
Sam: One more: add a small eval to Redwood Optimize to catch regressions from quantized cache paths. I can prototype next week.
Priya: Noted. Adding that as A6 (owner: Sam) — due: 2w.
Ravi: leaving a short note in the RCA about test scenarios that reproduce pressure. link: https://redwood.in/rca/203001#repro
Jordan: Excellent. Closing note — if anyone needs capacity or help triaging, ping @oncall and flag in #eng-oncall.
Taylor: Acked. I'll update the support playbook after comms draft is ready.
Mei: I'll follow up here when the staging rebalance passes smoke tests.
Jordan: Thanks all — appreciate the quick ownership.
